title_candidates: Meta's Muse Image can search, edit, and check its own work
summary: Muse Image is live in Meta AI with search-assisted generation, multi-image editing, and an invisible Content Seal; Muse Video remains a preview.

primary_source.title: Introducing Muse Image and Muse Video
primary_source.author: Meta Superintelligence Labs
key_facts: Muse Image can generate, edit, and combine several reference images.
The model can use web search and code to support image generation.
Images made in Meta AI receive an invisible Content Seal provenance signal.
Muse Video was previewed but was not generally available at publication.

prerequisites: An image you own or have permission to edit

steps.instruction: Open Meta AI and start an image-generation chat.
Create a simple poster with a title, one object, and two colors.
Change only the title while preserving the layout and colors.
Try one narrow edit on an image you own.
Inspect visual errors and label misleading contexts before sharing.

references.title: Introducing Muse Image and Muse Video
references.author: Meta Superintelligence Labs

risk_flags: Product availability varies by country; Muse Video is preview-only.
